newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha falls heavily, market sloppy.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha falls heavily, market sloppy.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices fell heavily on Wednesday in line with weaker crude with end-users relaxed amid signs of plentiful supplies.
A Tunisian full-range cargo in the hands of a trader was offered at $221 but no bids were heard.
Small Russian cargoes were also seen on offer on a mean/mean-related basis.
An Antwerp LVN cargo was heard traded but the price was not confirmed.
"It looks very sloppy," said one dealer. "If someone's got to sell it will be cheap."
The paper market also came off sharply, with Dec swaps either side of $220, Jan at $212/$214 after trading at $213 and Feb at $207/$209.
